text: Issuing a Duplicate/Replacement SIM Document ID: SOP_C05_SIM_REPLACEMENT Category: C05 — SIM Card Services Department: Customer Care Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To standardise the process for issuing a replacement SIM for lost, damaged, or swapped SIM cards while preventing fraudulent reissue. Scope Applies to all in-store and video-KYC based SIM replacement requests. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Verify customer identity against KYC records (photo ID match, or video-KYC liveness check). Confirm no active fraud flag exists on the account before proceeding. Issue new SIM with same number; deactivate old SIM as part of the same transaction. Instruct customer to restart device and confirm network registration before leaving the store / ending the session. Log the replacement reason code (lost/damaged/swap/device change) in the CRM. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling If fraud is suspected at any point, halt the process and route to SOP_C18_FRAUD_RESPONSE. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Unresolved
title: Issuing a Duplicate/Replacement SIM
